Claim: card thread · 2026-11-21T06:12Z · `Fixes #35678`. Supersedes the fold pointers that tied this card to #35878 / PR #35918 (withdrawn when the card was rewritten on 2026-11-20).
Area: b1-L
Session: `session_01L6bhgWRZyWba1HhfWN7hKy` (the card thread, building itself under the dev-thread rule)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-00juyj
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/` `components/BulkActionBar.tsx`, `components/SelectionPageBar.tsx` (deleted; never exported), `listPageBarSlot.ts`, `ObjectGrid.tsx` (selection bar render points, the row-actions column condition, the bottom spacing only), `index.tsx`, `components/RowContextMenu.tsx` if needed; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx`; `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (one spacer row only); `ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts` and its zod twin; tests (plugin-grid BulkActionBar and listPageBarSlot-35554, app-shell selection tests, `ui/e2e/list-no-actions-column-35554.spec.ts`, ListView tests); a changeset.
Container & model: `M/L`, `mode:thread`, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening: `DataTableSchema` gains one optional runtime spacer member, refused by name in the zod twin's authoring face; `BulkActionBar` keeps its published name; `useListPageBarHost` is renamed but is not in the published 18.6.0 package, checked with `npm pack`, so nothing published narrows). The seat runs the L2 at the tier the changed paths decide (declaration `TIER_DEFAULT` unless the paths read a schema face).
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: re-read on main `b113178d` by the card thread: holds. The list page portals `SelectionPageBar` into the page header slots; child tabs, the side record and embedded tables draw the bottom-pinned `BulkActionBar`; below 768 px `ObjectGrid` returns cards and draws no selection surface at all; the phone list has no bottom menu.
Basis: card #35678, a p2 child of epic #35547, which the maintainer handed to this seat on 2026-11-20 16:32Z; rewritten at the maintainer's ask on 2026-11-20.
Scope: one bar component. `BulkActionBar` becomes the bottom-centred floating bar and absorbs `SelectionPageBar`'s single/multi logic; the page header's "selected" face is removed in both places, so the top of the page does not change on selection. The phone card list hangs the same bar (above the safe area; #35883 adds the ways into selection and hides "+"). The main list's footer calculation row keeps its last row visible through a spacer row. Seat accepts the thread's readings: three actions or fewer are all buttons (delete included); more than three: the first three non-delete actions are buttons and the rest plus delete go under More; same rule for one record; narrow widths fold into More by measured width; Esc cancels at document level but not while an input, editor or popover is open; the non-table bottom bar in `ListView` (kanban and others) is out of scope per the card's "not doing", so "no full-width bottom bar left" reads as the table's bar.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. Overlap probe against main, #35994 and #35990: clean. #35883 and #35955 start in parallel on nearby files; `overlap-check.mjs` runs before each push. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.
